Speaking of Polls:
AOL Polled Its Members On Medical Marijuana The Day Of the IOM Report

March 17, 1999

Results as of 5:15
(Marijuananews note: I did not see the final numbers but the percentages remained the same all day.

The introduction and the questions here are a little tendentious. Notice that they say the "ingredients" not marijuana itself, and they use the word "legalize." They didn’t ask if doctors and patients should be arrested, so the results are interesting. This is not a scientific poll, but it should be a clue to Steve Case that he is out of touch with the AOL members.)
